primer: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Ltd (RPEL) is a debt-free (0.02x D/E) specialty consumable franchise earning 30.3% ROCE. It turned commodity silica ramming mass into a 30%-OPM product exported across 40 countries (48.59% of FY26 standalone turnover). Business quality earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS, though 272-day inventory triggers a PASS_WITH_WATCH flag. At ₹1,946.20 (126.8x P/E, ~389x FY26 FCF), the market prices in 33–36% annual FCF growth for 10 years, while 50x FY28E PAT yields ₹1,350 (-30.6%). Because ₹1,350 sits below CMP and the ₹1,756.29–₹1,845.67 support zone, RPEL is NOT_HELD and REJECTED on VALUATION, keeping 100% of marginal cash.
